latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of hallucination-detector.

- Detects and flags hallucinations in LLM outputs by checking claims against source code, documentation, and data.
- Classifies issues as fabrication, contradiction, exaggeration, outdated, or unverifiable.
- Provides confidence scores for each claim and detailed output reports.
- Supports integration into CI pipelines, RAG workflows, and AI content review processes.
- Includes detection of common hallucination patterns and actionable recommendations.
